subject: small tortoiseshell butterfly (Aglais urticae), a single butterfly as a pinned museum specimen seen from directly above, both pairs of wings spread fully open and perfectly flat in one plane, symmetrical, head at the top, slender dark body down the middle, two thin antennae: bright orange wings, the front edge of the forewings barred with black and pale yellow blocks, a white spot at each forewing tip, a dark rim round all four wings set with a row of small blue crescents, dark brown at the wing bases
